title: Belseco DOT Mega Pack
tag_line: Vapid-branded Belseco Department of Transportation fleet: heavy rescue, FIRST freeway service patrol, fleet pickups and winter operations.
description: A department-of-transportation fleet pack built around a fully interactive upfit: four-level emergency lightbar with selectable flash programs, four siren tones plus air horn, an eight-segment rear traffic advisor, a sequenced 15-lamp arrow board on a raise/stow mast, scene and alley lighting on a metered electrical load, and winter equipment with a ground-speed-metered spreader. Everything is driveable from the in-cab Belseco Fleet Console UI app, from bindable keys, or from the cab switch panel.
